description: This file defines a service for building travel advice for a city, including fetching weather, clothing, and places data via a backend client, and synthesizing human tips based on the collected data.

classes.name: WeatherInfo
classes.description: Data model representing weather information including summary, temperature, feels_like temperature, humidity, and wind speed.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Data model representing clothing item recommendations with optional reasons.

classes.name: PlaceInfo
classes.description: Data model representing information about a place, including name, category, description, and URL.

classes.name: TravelAdvice
classes.description: Comprehensive data model aggregating weather, clothing, places, and tips for travel suggestions.

methods.name: List[str] _synthesize_tips(weather: WeatherInfo, clothing: List[ClothingRecommendation], places: List[PlaceInfo])
methods.description: Creates human-readable travel tips based on weather, clothing, and place information.

methods.name: TravelAdvice build_travel_advice(city: str, client: BackendClient)
methods.description: Fetches data from backend client and synthesizes travel advice for a specified city.
